rows.new: search matches by name without accents and by phone digits
the default order puts the newest message on top; the opening order puts the oldest ticket on top
an empty file and an empty selection are both rejected
the cards count over the entire list
pinned items stay on top, the most recently pinned above the others, and the rest follow the normal order
polls the conversation quickly while a message is in transit
a document over 100 MB is rejected; audio over 20 MB is rejected even though it is under 100
today shows HH:mm; another day shows elapsed time without a suffix (card) or the abbreviated date (bubble)
more than ten files rejects the whole batch, reporting how many were sent
manually marked as unread appears in the "Unread" card even when the agent sent the last message
consecutive messages from the same side form a group; a note breaks it
the display name is never left blank
the delivery indicator is the one from the last bubble
average time with no value shows a dash, not zero
alphabetical order groups by letter and sends unnamed items to the end
template parameters and preferences with a default
closure card rule copied from Blip
last interaction groups by day, most recent first
an oversized file in the middle rejects the batch and names it
